title: Essential for new and old vegans!
body: This app has honestly been life changing for me. I’m a really busy person who hates cooking, but I have gotten so tired of only eating vegan chicken nuggets and fries because I have no other idea of what to eat, and this app has allowed me to fully go outside of my comfort zone with trying new foods, being confident that the foods that I’m buying are actually vegan, trying new restaurants with vegan options that I didn’t originally see, and just trying to cook a little bit more. It’s 100% worth the cost especially because it’s so low, and I think it is absolutely essential to be supporting vegan ventures in a time where more and more people are quitting veganism. I cannot recommend this app enough!!

title: Super useful tool for vegans/vegetarians/anyone interested in more plant based options!
body: I love that you can instantly open any recipe you find online right in the app and it handles the rest. I was worried it would only give you one plant based option, but it actually gives you several different ways to veganize every recipe, which is great! As a busy parent, this is already helping me tremendously with weeknight meal planning.
